text:
Riley Park: Hi finance — my corpcard had a charge `UBER *POOL 12.80` on 2025-01-14 but the driver receipt wasn't emailed and the app lost the image. I only have the trip history screen and the card statement. Can I still expense?

expenses-bot: Auto-check: Missing itemized receipt. For rides under $25 we accept trip history + card statement + brief note if no driver receipt. Manager approval required for pooled rides with shared fares.

Zoe Tan: @Riley please upload the trip history screenshot and the card txn screenshot. Also confirm if this was a client-related trip or commute.

Riley Park: Uploaded both: [uber_trip_011425.png], [card_txn_011425.png]. This was from SFO to client office for an afternoon demo with startup X. Not a commute.

Zoe Tan: Thanks. I'll approve since it's client-facing. Quick note: pooled trips should be avoided for client meetings going forward — prefer private rides for receipts.

Finance Ops: For GL coding use TRV-NA-CLIENT, vendor "Ride-share (pool)". We will reimburse the full $12.80. Add note in Ramp: "no driver receipt available; uploaded app trip history; manager approved".

Riley Park: Added note and submitted in Ramp. Appreciate it! :thumbsup:

expenses-bot: Expense accepted for review. Reference EXP-11258.
